top_story.title: Why Is Bitmine Immersion Stock Surging Friday?
top_story.summary: Bitmine Immersion Technologies Inc. (NYSE:BMNR) stock surged Friday, extending its gains from Thursday. Nasdaq futures rose 0.67%, while S&P 500 futures gained 0.43%.The move came as Bitcoin (CRYPTO: BTC) and Ethereum (CRYPTO: ETH) rallied, boosting the value of Bitmine’s digital asset holdings.
